node_definition.done_when: A test in tests/test_the_board_extends_the_directory.py asserts the directory for a power_convertor fixture lists every live run of every coordinator with its section and held paths, lists a coordinator that has ready-idle work but no run, and caps its rows with a limit and a cursor that pages the rest, where reckon/mcp_views.py returns the directory early with neither today. The board joins existing owners (reckon/crew/directory.py, the ready-idle filter, the scope check's binding verdict) and derives nothing itself; no crew view is added. Negative control, executed and logged: a coordinator whose only plan has no ready section and no run does not appear, and the test fails if it does. Gate: tests/test_the_board_extends_the_directory.py tests/test_mcp_tools.py. baseline_suite and after_suite are run with the project's armed suite command, PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_the_board_extends_the_directory.py, at the base and at the head, each log naming its revision, tree and literal command and ending EXIT=. Every test file that imports a production module the node changed adds no failure against a base arm: run both arms from git archive extractions on node-local disk with the main checkout's .env linked, record both logs, and re-run any id that differs between arms serially three times on each revision. ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. Run the gate in the foreground on the fleet allocation. Also remove two copies the lane-share node left in reckon/mcp_views.py. The lane-share block (around line 760) reads the lane document with json.loads and its own try/except; make it call lane_document.read_lane_document_file, as the same module already does at line 708. The per-session admission-row lookup (around line 765) copies reckon/crew/obligations.py:886-889; call the owner instead. tests/test_the_lane_share_lives_on_the_lanes_view.py keeps passing.
